title: All node packs live in ixdar.nodegraph.nodes: mesh, quad-layout, network and dungeon nodes move out of their domains
description:
User ruling (2026-10-17), on reviewing DSL-49: the quad-layout and network nodes DSL-49 moved to geometry/mesh/quadlayout/nodes 'probably need to be in the nodegraph package as well', and when asked, the user chose ALL node packs. Pure moves, classes keep their names:
- geometry/mesh/nodes/{primitives,modifier,data,curve,selection,transform,geometry,patch} -> nodegraph/nodes/<same leaf>
- geometry/mesh/quadlayout/nodes -> nodegraph/nodes/quadlayout (the four network nodes ArcNetworkNode, NetworkArc, NetworkNode, NetworkPatch -> nodegraph/nodes/network)
- procgen/dungeon/nodes -> nodegraph/nodes/dungeon
The algorithms the nodes call stay in their domains (geometry/mesh/*, quadlayout/*, procgen/dungeon/algo); algorithm classes that implement MeshNode directly (NDirectionField, MotorcycleGraph, SeamlessParameterization, LayoutEmbedding, NetworkContraction, GridMapAssembly, QuantizedMeshGrid) stay put here: splitting them into algorithm + node is MESH-63. Node categories are the required NodeCategory enum since ENG-17, so moving cannot change the catalog. Placed on top of the stack so nothing below is rewritten. Repo plan: $REPO_HOME/ai-workspace/reports/repo-plan-2026-10-17.md.
definition-of-done:
1. No class annotated @MeshNodeAnnotation lives outside ixdar.nodegraph except the algorithm-as-node classes MESH-63 splits (listed in package-info).
2. Behaviour unchanged: unit suite passes; docs/mesh-node-catalog.json identical except sourceClass/sourcePath-style fields; generated MeshNodeRegistry ids identical; every DSL fixture and the dungeon DSLs evaluate to the same fingerprints; ring and quad-suite fingerprints unchanged.
3. Moved packages carry package-info; ARCHITECTURE.md regenerated. No class renamed.
4. Launch entry and screenshot.
testing-plan:
1. mvn test; registry and catalog diff.
2. Fingerprints: ring fixtures, quad suite, dungeon DSLs.

Non-mechanical edits: nodegraph/nodes package-info (lists the 7 MESH-63 algorithm-as-node classes), new network package-info, quadlayout package-info drops the network half, geometry/mesh package-info drops 'mesh nodes', geometry/mesh/nodes package-info deleted, two {@link} FQNs (ArrayMeshEngine, InputParameterDescriptor).
